summary.en-US: Marks YouTube videos you have already watched. Community fork of Watchmarker; all data stays in your browser.

description.en-US:
Watchmarker Redo for YouTube marks the videos you have already watched, directly on YouTube's pages, without depending on YouTube's own watch history.

This is a community fork of [Watchmarker for Youtube](https://github.com/sniklaus/youtube-watchmarker), based on version 5.1.0 and updated for Firefox's Manifest V3 event pages. It fixes the intermittent failure that stopped marking videos until the extension was disabled and re-enabled, restores missing bundled assets, adds Shorts support, and keeps working after Firefox suspends the background page.

All data stays in your browser: the extension uses local storage and IndexedDB, has no telemetry, no analytics, no ads and no server of its own. It only contacts youtube.com and m.youtube.com using your existing session, as the original extension does. See the privacy policy for details.

Source code, issues and release notes: https://github.com/Jalkhov/youtube-watchmarker-redo

Licensed under GPL-3.0. Not affiliated with YouTube, Google, or the original author.

release_notes.en-US:
5.2.1

- Added 32, 64 and 128 px icon variants.
- No functional changes.

version.approval_notes: Community fork of Watchmarker for Youtube (GPL-3.0), based on the 5.1.0 source. No remote code, no eval, no telemetry and no developer server. All data stays in local storage and IndexedDB; the extension only talks to youtube.com and m.youtube.com with the user's session. The bundled minified libraries (jQuery 3.7.1, download.js 4.21, idb 8.0.3) are unmodified upstream release builds; UI icons are inline Lucide 1.62.0 SVGs. Versions, licenses and official URLs are documented in THIRD_PARTY.md. Full human-readable source: https://github.com/Jalkhov/youtube-watchmarker-redo
